questions.q: Who has been Prince of Liechtenstein since 1989?
questions.why: His son Alois has run daily affairs since 2004.

questions.q: Which empire's breakup in 1806 left Liechtenstein independent?
questions.why: It joined the Confederation of the Rhine.

questions.q: What did Liechtenstein abolish in 1868?
questions.why: It has had no army since then.

questions.q: How many soldiers did Liechtenstein send to its last war in 1866, and how many returned?
questions.why: An Italian friend came back with them.

questions.q: What is the capital of Liechtenstein?
questions.why: Its castle is the prince's home.

questions.q: What kind of state is Liechtenstein?
questions.why: It is ruled by a prince.

questions.q: Which two countries border Liechtenstein?
questions.why: It is doubly landlocked.

questions.q: Which river forms Liechtenstein's border with Switzerland?
questions.why: It flows north to Lake Constance.

questions.q: Which mountain range covers Liechtenstein?
questions.why: Its highest peak is Grauspitz.

questions.q: What is Liechtenstein's highest mountain?
questions.why: It is about 2,600 m high.

questions.q: Which winter sport has won Liechtenstein its Olympic medals?
questions.why: Hanni Wenzel won two golds in 1980.

questions.q: Which skier won Liechtenstein two golds at the 1980 Olympics?
questions.why: Her brother also won medals.

questions.q: Which Liechtenstein skier won Olympic super-G bronze in 2018?
questions.why: Her mother is Hanni Wenzel.

questions.q: Which art museum in Vaduz is a black concrete cube?
questions.why: It opened in 2000.

questions.q: What is Liechtenstein's currency?
questions.why: It has used it since 1924.

questions.q: What is the official language of Liechtenstein?
questions.why: A local Alemannic dialect is spoken.

questions.q: In which year did Liechtenstein become a principality?
questions.why: It was created in the Holy Roman Empire.

questions.q: In which year did Liechtenstein give women the vote?
questions.why: It was one of the last in Europe.

questions.q: Which country handles Liechtenstein's foreign embassies in many places?
questions.why: They also share a customs union.

questions.q: Which economic area does Liechtenstein belong to?
questions.why: It joined in 1995.

questions.q: Which noble family bought the lands that became Liechtenstein?
questions.why: They came from Austria.

questions.q: Which country is the fourth-smallest in Europe?
questions.why: It is about 160 square kilometres.

questions.q: Which Alpine resort is Liechtenstein's ski area?
questions.why: It is in the mountains above Triesenberg.

questions.q: What are Liechtenstein's postage stamps famous among?
questions.why: Stamps were once a major income.

questions.q: Which castle above Vaduz is home to the prince?
questions.why: It is not open to the public.

questions.q: Which industry made Liechtenstein rich?
questions.why: It has one of the highest incomes per person.

questions.q: Which Liechtenstein company is a world leader in false teeth?
questions.why: It makes dental materials.

questions.q: Which Liechtenstein company makes power tools for builders?
questions.why: It is based in Schaan.

questions.q: What is the national day of Liechtenstein?
questions.why: Fireworks light up Vaduz.

questions.q: Which dish of cheese noodles is Liechtenstein's favourite?
questions.why: It is topped with fried onions.
